svg.text: AU Bank Insurance Platform - Full HLD with Release Scope
Same topology as the R0 HLD, coloured by when each box enters the programme. R0 is the assisted Term pilot slice; R1/R2+ deepen the same spine - they do not invent a second architecture.
R0 - assisted Term pilot (build now after S08/S09)
R1 - after a real assisted sale (DIY, Group B, deepen)
R2+ - renewals, NTB, non-life, direct adapters, control tower
Edge - WAF / CDN / API Gateway (only public entry)
AWS ap-south-1 EKS private subnets | DR warm standby ap-south-2 | database-per-service (ARCH-004)
R0 workforce | R1+ retail customer auth
R0 assisted state machine | R1 DIY+hybrid modes | R2+ servicing journeys
DATA ENGINES (why not one MongoDB for everything)
idempotency - not quote payload cache in R0
Quote = DynamoDB jobs; Proposal = Aurora integrity.
WHAT THIS ARCHITECTURE ACHIEVES (and what each release unlocks)
R0 - prove one lawful assisted sale
C1 suitability gate, C2 consent evidence, C4 customer-device pay,
issued+reconciled policy, immutable audit, Hub in front of 1SB,
Flutter RM UI. Foundation S08/S09 first. No quote payload cache.
Success = one RM completes Term Life end-to-end in pilot.
Customer BFF + DIY app, Group B redirect, ULIP/Savings,
Lead bulk/campaign, Admin UI, full MIS, richer notification,
optional suitability-bound offer cache, vernacular hi-IN.
Starts only after a real assisted policy is sold.
Health/Motor after WS-1 Phase 5, Direct Insurer adapters
Domains stable; only adapters and depth change.
